title: A Man in a Chucky-Style Mask Was Scaring Philadelphians. Then He Picked the Wrong Woman.
summary: When Jameka Wilson encountered a man wearing a Chucky-style Halloween mask, her stage combat training kicked in. Now she’s a minor local celebrity.
